name: Tabs
description: A tab list whose active indicator springs between tabs as a sliding underline or pill, with panels that slide or fade in the direction of travel. Supports arrow-key, Home and End navigation and both controlled and uncontrolled use.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA Tabs pattern: role=tablist with aria-label, role=tab buttons with aria-selected and aria-controls, and role=tabpanel regions labelled by their tab. Roving tabindex keeps a single Tab stop; Left/Right arrows move between tabs (wrapping), Home/End jump to the ends, disabled tabs are skipped. activationMode 'automatic' selects on focus, 'manual' selects with Enter/Space. The panel is focusable so Tab moves straight into its content. Under prefers-reduced-motion the indicator jumps and panels only cross-fade.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.type: { value: string; label: string; content?: React.ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }[]
propsApi.description: Tabs to render with their panel content.

propsApi.name: activationMode
